definition: In this source, critical range means the essential set or span of information needed for a specific surveillance purpose. It refers to data broad enough to support active case investigation and screening for likely tuberculosis cases.

reasons: The definition’s interpretation of “critical range” as “the essential set or span of information needed for a specific surveillance purpose” is not explicitly stated in the packet; the packet only says the platform “collects a critical range of data” for particular TB activities.

The definition adds “data broad enough to support active case investigation and screening for likely tuberculosis cases,” but the packet instead uses the terms “active case investigation” and “presumptive case screening” for identifying/detecting “confirmed TB cases,” without stating “likely tuberculosis cases.”

The packet describes the purpose in TB surveillance terms (active case investigation/presumptive case screening and identifying confirmed TB cases), but the definition reframes it with additional general wording (“essential set,” “specific surveillance purpose,” “likely tuberculosis cases”) that is not directly supported by the provided text.

The packet supports that GPMS TB Transportal collects a "critical range of data" for active case investigation and presumptive case screening, but it does not define the phrase as an "essential set or span of information" for a surveillance purpose.
The statement about "screening for likely tuberculosis cases" goes beyond the packet’s wording, which refers to "presumptive case screening" and to identifying and detecting confirmed TB cases.
